text.en:
Upon scoring 50% of Magazine as Precision Hits:
20% increased damage for 11 seconds.

Can be refreshed by scoring enough precision hits.

Stowing or reloading will reset the precision counter. Buff persists through stow if active.

enhanced (
#e Buff Duration is increased to 12 seconds.
)
text.zh-chs:
弹匣的一半弹药造成精准伤害后：
+20% 伤害，持续 11 秒。

达到足够精确命中数后可刷新持续时间。

收枪或装填将重置精确命中计数。该特性触发后，收枪也会维持武器的增益效果。

enhanced (
#e 增益持续时间提升到 12 秒。
)

20% increased damage for #e${11+#d} seconds.

Stowing or Reloading resets the Precision Hit counter but the buff remains active while stowed.
